prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Subject: the adult fictional character Jessica Sherawat in her scuba equipment from Resident Evil Revelations HD on PC (2013). Use the supplied official Steam promotional image as the only visual reference: the single woman on the right wearing the black and purple mission wetsuit. Preserve her exact recognizable face, brown hair, black open-face swim hood, folded purple-lined collar, small breathing hose, black gloves, forearm equipment, harness, polished black suit and purple stripes. Preserve asymmetric native costume: HER LEFT leg is fully covered by the black and purple suit with a diving knife strapped to the left outer shin; HER RIGHT leg has the original exposed leg section, original thigh straps and black lower boot. The left upper arm carries the original rectangular screen unit. Preserve the source proportions and the original black heeled footwear, no extra accessories. Render as detailed semi-realistic painted 2D videogame art for Resident Evil Combat, not vector, pixel art, or photo. The pose is alert and professional; no glamour pose, body emphasis or erotic framing. True transparent RGBA background. Remove background and original logo from the result. No text, watermark, labels, panel borders or multiple views. No outfit from snow missions, FBC, Revelations 2, or later ports. Do not add unseen decorations to the front of the suit. Produce one full-body static sprite in a restrained combat-ready pose with feet apart and knees slightly flexed, holding her small black pistol safely at chest-level ready position, no firing. Use a THREE-QUARTER REAR camera angle comparable to the reference, enough to see the face in profile and the equipment on her back and sides. Her head, gaze and muzzle point to image LEFT. Keep physical left/right costume asymmetry fixed, do not mirror it. All limbs and every part of both boots and firearm visible. Subject height at most 75 percent of square canvas, generous empty border above hood and below boots. Aim for a 2048 by 2048 square image. One character, one pose, not a sprite sheet. Neutral soft lighting reveals suit details without altering source colors. Preserve reference view features; do not invent hidden chest details.
